user.title: PowerShades
user.description:
Enter your PowerShades **RF gateway** address (local, e.g. `10.0.30.239`).

Cloud credentials (API key **or** e-mail+password) are optional and only add **cloud groups** (absolute-position moves). Local up/down/stop does **not** need them.

**Groups** (optional): one per line, `Name: 1,2,3`

Example:
```
Great Room: 1,2,3
Office: 4,5
```

name.title: Name channels
name.description: Name each linked channel (**{count}** found) so it can be controlled and found by name (e.g. `FIREPLACE`, `SIDE LEFT`). Leave blank to fall back to channel numbers. You can change these later in the entry **Options**.

error.credential_conflict: Use either an API key **or** e-mail+password, not both.
error.gateway_unreachable: Could not reach the RF gateway. Check the address / network.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the PowerShades cloud API.

init.title: Rename channels
init.description: Give each linked channel a name it will be controlled by (e.g. `FIREPLACE`, `SIDE LEFT`). {count} channels linked. Leave blank to keep channel numbers.
